name: BOWEN, the Hon. Christopher (Chris) Eyles

headline.note: The documented post-university career before federal Parliament consists of political staff employment and union work, alongside elected local office and council-association governance. Those categories are excluded from both headline sectors. Hours, exact transition dates and any earlier paid work remain unresolved; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official ministerial biography confirms the degree; reliable secondary biography gives 1994 graduation. Enrolment date and study load were not established.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary biography supplies employer, role and year endpoints. Exact appointment/payroll dates, hours and leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary biography supplies employer, role and year endpoints. Exact dates, hours and leave are unresolved; representing finance workers is not employment by finance-sector businesses.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary and government/party biographies establish nine years on Fairfield Council. Exact election and cessation dates, remuneration and hours are unresolved; the role overlaps the union and political-staff sequence.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected local office is excluded under the codebook and not added to overlapping employment.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies record mayoral service in 1998–1999. This is nested in councillor service; exact term dates and hours are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded and the nested interval is not double-counted.

career_spells.employer: Western Sydney Regional Organisation of Councils
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliamentary biography and a contemporaneous 2001 NSW parliamentary record establish the presidency. It arose from council representation and overlaps councillor/employment spells; pay, exact dates and hours are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Council-association representative leadership is treated as elected-office/governance and excluded.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary biography supplies role and year endpoints. Exact appointment/payroll dates, hours, leave and the 2000 transition from the union are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Paul Scully MLA (payroll entity unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary biography supplies role and year endpoints. Exact promotion/cessation dates, payroll entity, hours and campaign leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Griffith University and University of New England
career_spells.role: Master of International Relations and Diploma in Modern Languages (Bahasa Indonesia) study
career_spells.evidence_note: Qualifications and institutions are corroborated, but enrolment/completion dates and study load are unresolved. No employment status is inferred from study.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Member for Prospect, then McMahon; ministerial and shadow roles nested within service
career_spells.evidence_note: Official sources record continuous House service from 9 October 2004, first for Prospect and later McMahon. Ministerial/shadow appointments are nested duties, not additive employment spells. Null end means ongoing at the frozen snapshot.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

open_questions: Did Bowen have paid employment before the 1994 Janice Crosio role or during university?
What are the exact appointment dates, payroll entities, substantive hours, leave and campaign breaks for the 1994–2004 staff and union sequence?
What were the exact term/remuneration arrangements for Fairfield Council, mayor and WSROC roles, and did any constitute separate paid employment?
When were the Griffith and UNE postgraduate qualifications undertaken, and did they overlap paid work?
